confidence_notes: Current Adelaide cost-of-living aggregates support the meal, coffee and beer anchors; cocktail and wine prices are less certain and use their typical relationship to beer. Accommodation values are holistic estimates without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Adelaide is a large Australian regional capital. For accommodation, I use a level broadly like Perth or Brisbane outside major event peaks and below Sydney or Melbourne; food and drink anchors reflect Adelaide-specific price aggregates.
